name: Difficult
storyline:
At the start of each match, every player receives a hidden role. You might be part of the Town trying to uncover the cult, a Cultist secretly working against everyone, or a Solo role with its own unpredictable objective.

Nobody knows who to trust.

Lie, investigate, accuse, and survive long enough to reach your victory.

Survive the Day
When the sun rises, players gather to talk about what happened during the night.

Who acted suspiciously?
Who might be lying?

Players can accuse each other and start a vote. If the town agrees, the suspected player is executed.

But be careful. One wrong vote can eliminate an innocent player and bring the cult closer to victory.

Act in the Night
When night falls, every role secretly performs its ability.

Some players investigate houses to gather information. Others protect their allies. Cultists quietly hunt their targets while solo roles move toward their own hidden goals.

The events of the night often change everything the next day.
summary: Step into a fully 3D medieval world of deception. diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction game where you must uncover hidden cultists. Use proximity voice chat, investigate houses at night, survive daily votes, and reveal who is truly on your side.
